t: HYUN, New York City - Midtown - Restaurant Reviews, Photos & Reservations - Tripadvisor
s: Came here Saturday night with friends—had reservations but we ended having to wait a bit for our table (for 6 ppl). The restaurant was extremely hot, they had the heat turned up so high everyone was struggling to stay cool—we voiced our concerns several times. Our party got the HYUN-makase, supposedly all-you-can-eat wagyu for $159.
